units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:5">Tosef. Sabb. XVI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 17:5">XVII</cite>), 5 <he>מ׳ של בעלי … כלים</he> (ed. Zuck. <cite ref="M01199"><he>מים</he></cite> for <he>כלים</he>, corr. acc.) a domestic clothes-press which has been unscrewed to take out clothes.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 20:5">Sabb. XX, 5</cite> <he>מ׳ … מתירין וכ׳</he> you may unscrew a domestic clothes-press but not screw it (on the Sabbath).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 20:5">Ib.</cite> (<he>מ׳</he>)<he>של כובסין</he> the washers’ clothes-press.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:7">Kel. XVI, 7</cite> <he>מ׳ של חרש</he> the carpenter’s vise (for straightening wood), v. <cite ref="M01354"><he>מְכַוֵּון</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 1:8">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. I, 8</cite> <he>מכביש של נגר</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 1:15">Ib. 15</cite> <he>מ׳ של שכף וכ׳</he> the leather worker’s press on which he stretches the hides.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 20:5:1">Y. Sabb. XX, end, 17ᵈ</cite>; a. e.
